look_here_first: Locate cream to white SPHERICAL flower HEADS, not the elongated flower SPIKES of Gregg's/Wright's catclaw. Check hooked twig prickles and a whole bipinnate leaf before confirming from fruit.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Thorny shrub to small tree of calcareous rocky ground.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate bipinnate; regional floristic key generally 2–4 pinna pairs per leaf, about 6–13 leaflet pairs per pinna, cuneate-oblong leaflets with often glaucous undersides.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Short-stalked creamy to white globular/subglobular flower heads (<2x as long as broad), many tiny staminate-looking florets with long protruding stamens.

key_traits.label: Armature
key_traits.text: Recurved catclaw prickles on woody stems, not paired straight nodal stipular spines.

key_traits.label: Pods
key_traits.text: Flattened sometimes curved leathery pods; check mature shape, not isolated pod alone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Cream-white ROUND flower heads, not narrow flower spikes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Bipinnate leaves, cuneate-oblong leaflets often pale below
